thresholds._comment: Green band of the end-of-mission acceptance (docs/battle-theatre/GOVERNANCE/FINAL-ACCEPTANCE.md, step 5). Any value outside the band is a defect: there is no amber that passes. Never loosen these to make a pass clean.

frames._note: p95 frame time of requestAnimationFrame deltas while the map animation plays at 1x and 4x. maxJankFrameMs is reported as a defect only when more than 1 percent of frames exceed it.

heap._note: (heap after the final forced GC - heap after warm-up and a forced GC) / heap after warm-up, over the soak. Default soak is 120 s for dry runs; the acceptance run uses --soak-seconds 600.

setup._note: Mapbox requests per pass through the Referer-injecting side channel of tests/t0/lib.mjs (harness default 300 per run). Mapbox bills map loads (one sku per GL JS initialisation), not tile requests; every pass reports the number of skus it used. Override with --tile-cap.
